description.en: The name of the LiveChannel. The LiveChannel must exist.

description.zh:
设置LiveChannel的Status。
有效值：
- enabled：启用LiveChannel
- disabled：禁用LiveChannel
description.en:
The status of the LiveChannel.
Valid values:
- enabled: enables the LiveChannel
- disabled: disables the LiveChannel.

descriptions.zh:
- LiveChannel处于disabled状态时，OSS会禁止您向该LiveChannel进行推流操作。如果您正在向该LiveChannel推流，那么推流的客户端会被强制断开（会有10s左右的延迟）。
- 当没有客户端向该LiveChannel推流时，调用PutLiveChannelStatus重新创建LiveChannel也可以达到修改Status的目的。
- 当有客户端向该LiveChannel推流时，只能将LiveChannel的状态修改为disabled，无法调用PutLiveChannelStatus重新创建LiveChannel。
descriptions.en:
- When a LiveChannel is in the disabled state, OSS prohibits you from streaming to the LiveChannel. If you are streaming to the LiveChannel, the streaming client is forcibly disconnected (with a delay of approximately 10 seconds).
- When no client is streaming to the LiveChannel, you can call PutLiveChannelStatus to re-create the LiveChannel to change the Status.
- When a client is streaming to the LiveChannel, you can only change the LiveChannel status to disabled. You cannot call PutLiveChannelStatus to re-create the LiveChannel.
